verdict.correction: qou-rhyp graded inversion and Landen as hard-but-provable analysis. Two of them (hinv1, hlan1) are instead FALSE for a Rogers L built on the corpus's LiTwo, because their arguments w1 = 2.2469796... and -w1 leave the disc of convergence, where Lean's tsum is the junk value 0 and Real.log is even.
verdict.repair: definitional, not analytic: extend by inversion above 1 and Landen below 0 (Zagier SS I.3). All four reduction hypotheses then hold by construction. Formalised sorry-free in QOU/QBeta/FiveTwoRogersExtend.lean, generic in f and c, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
verdict.what_the_repair_costs: the Lean object is a piecewise function, NOT proved equal to the analytic continuation of Li_2. G7 checks they agree at the six points in play. Agreement is evidence, not identification.
verdict.net_effect: of the twelve hypotheses numerators_original_form takes, four reduction ones are now discharged for any f, and reflection transports through the extension. The genuinely open input is exactly the three five-term instances hA, hB, hC.
verdict.why_missed: route11's probe used mpmath polylog -- the true analytic continuation -- so it was testing the mathematics, not the Lean semantics. Both were right on their own terms; the gap was between them.
